generateWebsiteSchema

Generates WebSite and Organization schema for the homepage.

  • @returns JSON-LD entities

generateCarouselItemListSchema

Generates an ItemList matching Google Carousel rich results guidelines — position is 1-based per the spec, and image is only emitted when the item carries a src (an absent property beats an empty one for parsers).

  • @returns ItemList entity, or null when there is nothing to list.

(module scope)

Recursively walks project sections (nested arrays of text strings and media descriptors) yielding every node that carries a src. The generator shape keeps traversal total — media descriptors are leaf objects, so a matched node is yielded rather than descended into.

firstSectionText

First text string in the nested sections array — the same paragraph the project view promotes to the meta description, reused here so Article/VideoObject descriptions match the emitted page text.

videoObjectFor

VideoObject entity for one media descriptor — contentUrl/embedUrl point at the CDN mp4 and thumbnailUrl at its jpg poster, the two URLs Google's video crawler needs to index the asset.

generateProjectArticleSchema

Generates an Article and cover VideoObject graph for a project detail page. The Article image carries the real CDN asset — the full uncompressed mozjpg for image covers, the video poster for video covers — since the hypothetical aspect-ratio variants (-16x9/-4x3/ -1x1) never existed on the bucket and 404'd for crawlers.

  • @param project - Project translation data
  • @param slug - Project URL slug
  • @param locale - Page locale (defaults to LOCALES.EN)
  • @returns Array of Schema.org entities

generateBreadcrumbSchema

BreadcrumbList entity from an ordered crumb trail — positions are 1-based per the spec. Returns null for an empty/absent trail so callers can spread the result unconditionally.

  • @param items Ordered crumbs ending at the current page.
  • @param id Optional @id the page entity's breadcrumb can point at.
  • @returns BreadcrumbList entity or null.

generateRouteSchema

Base per-route JSON-LD graph — Organization + WebSite (localized inLanguage) + WebPage + optional BreadcrumbList. Emitted on every navigation so crawlers never see a stale homepage graph on deep links; views that own richer entities (project Article, docs TechArticle) replace or extend this graph once their data resolves.

  • @param options Route URL/name/description/locale/image/breadcrumb.
  • @returns JSON-LD entities for updateJsonLd().

generateProjectSchema

Complete project-page JSON-LD graph — the route base (Org + WebSite

  • WebPage + breadcrumb) plus the project Article, a media ItemList whose entries deep-link to the emitted /portfolio/

    / URLs (Google's carousel surface), and one VideoObject per section video alongside the cover video the Article builder already emits. When a mediaSlug deep link is active the graph recenters on that media: the WebPage gets the media URL + label + its own asset, a third crumb level appears, and a dedicated ImageObject/VideoObject leads the graph — matching the static media pages the generator emits.

  • @param project Localized project translation node.
  • @param slug Canonical project slug.
  • @param locale Page locale (defaults to LOCALES.EN).
  • @param mediaSlug Active media deep-link segment (params.slug).
  • @returns JSON-LD entities for updateJsonLd().

(module scope)

Minimal manifest-node shape the docs schema reads — kept structural so core never imports from experiments.

generateDocsSchema

Generates the docs-portal JSON-LD graph for a resolved docs path: a BreadcrumbList mirroring the on-page crumb trail plus one page entity — CollectionPage for the portal root and folders, TechArticle for file pages (markdown/code/report payloads). English is the only docs locale, so inLanguage is fixed to en.

  • @param docsPath Manifest-relative path ('' → the portal root).
  • @param node Resolved manifest node (null at the root / on misses).
  • @returns JSON-LD entities for updateJsonLd().

updateJsonLd

Dynamically updates the JSON-LD script graph in the document head. Maintains exactly one <script type="application/ld+json"> node — an array payload is wrapped in a @graph container so a single script can carry the whole entity set (the form Google's parsers prefer), and textContent (not innerHTML) writes it since JSON must not go through the HTML parser. Passing null/undefined REMOVES the node — routes that own a page-scoped graph (docs TechArticle, project Article) clear it on teardown so the entity never leaks onto the next route.

  • @param graph Entity or entity array; null/undefined removes the node.
